suggestions.topic: Hegota EIP tier rankings review and consensus building
suggestions.rationale: Client teams were required to publish S/A/B/D rankings by September 10 (4 days ago). With DevCon approaching, rough consensus on Hegota scope is needed before the conference. This is blocking forward progress on fork planning.

Deferred from ACDC #185 and #186, originally proposed for October 26 contingent on stable devnets. With Sepolia fork set for October 6, Hoodi timeline needs finalization to maintain testnet rollout momentum.

suggestions.topic: DevNet 10 status and Glamsterdam fork transition stability
suggestions.rationale: DevNet 9 failed with critical bugs (Prysm Gloas transition failure, Grandine OOM, Teku memory issues, same-hash-as-parent halting). DevNet 10 was planned for week of Sept 8 pending fixes. Sepolia forks Oct 6, so stable fork transition must be demonstrated urgently.

Expected revisit at ~2 weeks from ACDC #186 (Sept 3), putting it around Sept 17 — close to this call. Specs and POC implementations are ready for custom sweep thresholds and withdrawal credential pre-registration.

suggestions.topic: EIP-8037 Glamsterdam deployment status across all clients
suggestions.rationale: Cross-frame state gas fix was approved for Glamsterdam in ACDC #186. Geth/Erigon already deployed on DevNet 8, but ethrex was 1-2 days out. With Sepolia fork Oct 6, all clients must confirm readiness.

suggestions.topic: Optimism and Lido Glamsterdam testing window on stable devnet
suggestions.rationale: ACDC #185 noted Lido needs ≥1 day (preferably 2) on stable devnet before fork; Optimism also requested testing. DevNets 9 and 10 had stability issues, so testing window must be confirmed before Sepolia Oct 6 fork.

suggestions.topic: Parent-hash equality check spec fix implementation status
suggestions.rationale: Critical bug (block with same hash as parent halts network) was discovered on DevNet 8. Consensus-specs PR #5594 and beta.0 release were planned for Sept 3. All clients should confirm implementation and testing status.
